result.summary: Lightweight re-confirmation pass following the original Step 5 PASS (handoffs/WF02-REQ-024/step-05-release-validator.json, commit c3f8116). BACKEND-DEV fixed it in commit 5a56bad (lockfile-only, verified npm ci succeeds and platform-entry counts match master exactly, no application code touched). REVIEWER re-gated in commit 0ff7552 (PASS, independently confirmed the fix is lockfile-only and reproduced green npm ci/lint/build/test locally). Zero application code (src/, apps/web, apps/bot) changed in this range beyond what Step 6 already touched -- confirms BACKEND-DEV's and REVIEWER's own claims rather than trusting them. 2. Ran npm ci myself (the exact command CI invokes) from a clean state: succeeded cleanly, 590 packages added / 593 audited, 0 vulnerabilities, no lockfile-integrity errors. 3. Ran npm run lint myself: 0 errors, 2 pre-existing apps/web LCP warnings (Footer.tsx, Nav.tsx) -- unrelated to this diff, matches every prior gate's report. 4. Ran npm run build myself: apps/web (Next.js 16.3.2 / Turbopack) compiled successfully, TypeScript clean, all routes generated; apps/bot (tsc -p tsconfig.json) clean, zero errors. 5. Ran npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism myself from the repo root: 19 test files passed, 171 tests passed / 46 skipped (217 total) -- identical shape to the original Step 5 run's no-DB pass (same self-skip guard firing correctly for the DB-dependent suite in this environment). 6. Checked the actual GitHub PR #55 CI status myself via gh pr checks 55 (single bounded call, no watch loop): build check is PASS on both recorded runs (1m48s and 1m34s). deploy-qa and deploy-prod show 'skipping', which is expected and correct for an open, unmerged feature-branch PR (these gates run post-merge). Confirmed via gh pr view 55 --json headRefOid,state,mergeable that the PR's headRefOid (0ff7552454a2d7a84e8798f3cf0a7cd4d2e0f24d) matches this branch's HEAD exactly, state is OPEN, mergeable is MERGEABLE. Conclusion: the lockfile fix is confirmed lockfile-only end to end -- no application code regression risk, CI is genuinely green on the real PR (not just locally), and the original AC1/AC2/AC3 + integration verification from c3f8116 remains fully valid since nothing it depended on changed.
